title: Analogy Generation by Prompting Large Language Models: A Case Study of InstructGPT

benchmarks.name: Standard Science Analogies (STD)
benchmarks.relevance_reason: A dataset of science analogies used to evaluate an LLM's ability to generate analogous concepts, an open-ended creative task.
benchmarks.origin_paper: Turney, 2008. The latent relation mapping engine: Algorithm and experiments.

tasks.name: Analogous Concept Generation (Feasibility Analysis)
tasks.description: Given one of ten well-known science concepts (the target), the task is to generate an analogous source concept and explanation. This was used for an initial feasibility study.
tasks.scoring_detail: Manual count of exact matches to the reference source concept and count of 'valid' (meaningful) generated analogies.

benchmarks.name: Science analogies from academic Q&A sites (SAQA)
benchmarks.relevance_reason: A new dataset of science analogies created to evaluate LLM performance on generating and explaining analogies, which are open-ended creative reasoning tasks.

tasks.name: Analogous Concept Generation (ACG / NO_SRC)
tasks.description: Given only a target concept, the model must generate an analogous source concept along with an explanation. This task was used for robustness analysis (prompts, temperature, spelling errors) and model size comparison.
tasks.model_type_notes: InstructGPT models of four sizes were tested: Ada, Babbage, Curie, and Davinci.
tasks.scoring_detail: Automatic metrics (BLEURT, METEOR, ROUGE-L) comparing generated text to reference analogies, and human evaluation rating analogies as 'meaningful' (Yes/No).

tasks.name: Analogy Explanation Generation (AEG / WSRC)
tasks.description: Given both a target concept and an analogous source concept, the model must generate an explanation of their similarity. This task was used for robustness analysis (prompts, temperature) and model size comparison.
tasks.model_type_notes: InstructGPT models of four sizes were tested: Ada, Babbage, Curie, and Davinci.
tasks.scoring_detail: Automatic metrics (BLEURT, METEOR, ROUGE-L) comparing generated text to reference explanations, and human evaluation rating explanations as 'meaningful' (Yes/No).

title: Creating Suspenseful Stories: Iterative Planning with Large Language Models

benchmarks.name: Human Evaluation of Suspenseful Story Generation
benchmarks.relevance_reason: Introduces a new set of human evaluation tasks for a creative AI generation capability (suspenseful storytelling), using open-ended generation and reporting empirical results with LLMs.

tasks.name: Comparative Story Evaluation
tasks.description: Human participants perform pairwise comparisons of stories generated by the proposed method against baselines (vanilla LLM, Re3) and ablated versions. Stories are judged on five criteria: Suspense, Novelty, Enjoyment, Logical Sense, and Naturalness.
tasks.model_type_notes: ChatGPT (gpt-3.5-turbo-0613) and Llama 2 (Llama-2-13b-chat) were tested.
tasks.scoring_detail: Pairwise preference (Win/Lose/Tie) on Suspense, Novelty, Enjoyment, Logical Sense, and Naturalness.

tasks.name: Story Outline Examination
tasks.description: Human participants evaluate generated story outlines to assess the relevance of protagonist actions to the goal, the plausibility of failure reasons, and whether the likelihood of subsequent actions is perceived as decreasing.
tasks.task_type_notes: The task evaluates the intermediate output (outline) of the generation process.
tasks.scoring_detail: Percentage agreement on action relevance, failure reason plausibility, and perceived trend of action likelihood (decreasing/increasing/same).

tasks.name: Suspense Factor Intervention Study
tasks.description: Controlled human studies comparing pairs of stories with specific interventions to test their effect on perceived suspense. Interventions include adding clues of impending failure and varying the timing of revealing failure reasons (before vs. after the event).
tasks.scoring_detail: Pairwise preference (Win/Lose/Tie) on suspense level.

tasks.name: Empathy-Suspense Correlation Study
tasks.description: Human participants read a generated story and provide ratings on a 5-point scale for the level of empathy they feel for the protagonist and the level of suspense they perceive.
tasks.scoring_detail: 5-point Likert scale ratings for Empathy and Suspense.

title: Probing the Creativity of Large Language Models: Can models produce divergent semantic association?

benchmarks.name: Divergent Association Task (DAT)
benchmarks.relevance_reason: A quantitative, objective measure of divergent thinking (a core component of creativity) by calculating the semantic distance between generated words. It is applied to evaluate and compare multiple LLMs against human performance.

tasks.name: Unrelated Noun Generation
tasks.description: Models are prompted to generate 10 nouns that are as semantically unrelated to each other as possible. The semantic distance between the generated words is then calculated.
tasks.scoring_detail: Average pairwise cosine distance between GLoVe word embeddings of the first 7 valid nouns (DAT score); average surprisal (negative log word frequency).

tasks.name: Base
tasks.description: A control condition where models are prompted to simply 'write 10 nouns' without any instruction for divergence, to establish a baseline of semantic association.
tasks.scoring_detail: Average pairwise cosine distance between GLoVe word embeddings (DAT score).

tasks.name: Random
tasks.description: A control condition where models are prompted to 'write 10 nouns randomly' to test their ability to modulate output towards divergence compared to the standard DAT prompt.
tasks.scoring_detail: Average pairwise cosine distance between GLoVe word embeddings (DAT score).

title: IconShop: Text-Guided Vector Icon Synthesis with Autoregressive Transformers

tasks.description: Generate vector icons from text prompts (keywords and natural language sentences) to evaluate generation quality, diversity, and text-icon alignment.
tasks.model_type_notes: The model is an autoregressive transformer that generates tokenized SVG command sequences based on text input.
tasks.scoring_detail: Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) using CLIP image encoder, Uniqueness, Novelty, CLIP Score

tasks.name: Subjective User Study
tasks.description: Human evaluation of generated icons for perceptual quality (for both random and text-guided generation) and semantic alignment with text prompts.
tasks.task_type_notes: The generation of icons is the subject of the human evaluation.
tasks.scoring_detail: Percentage of icons rated as high-quality; Percentage of times selected as best quality; Percentage of times selected as best text-alignment

tasks.name: Icon Editing
tasks.description: Demonstrates the model's ability to fill in missing parts of an icon based on bidirectional context, with or without text guidance.
tasks.scoring_detail: Qualitative visual assessment

tasks.name: Icon Interpolation
tasks.description: Demonstrates smooth transitions in the learned latent space by generating icons from interpolated text embeddings between two concepts.
tasks.scoring_detail: Qualitative visual assessment

tasks.name: Icon Semantic Combination
tasks.description: Demonstrates the model's ability to generate creative icons by combining the semantics of different text prompts.
tasks.scoring_detail: Qualitative visual assessment

tasks.name: Icon Design Auto-Suggestion
